log.t: Rafe and Pip are now close friends.

New lead: Lumber Yard (Medium risk, 3 h trip). Open Explore to send a squad. It's gone in about 10 hours.

Scrapyard: all materials are in, building now.
📻 The Foundry: People keep talking about the Haven. Fine. You've earned it. Don't let it go to your head.
Eli scrounged some scrap.

Tess couldn't take another day without food and left to find somewhere better.

Leo and Zane are now friends.
Milo will staff the Scrapyard.
Scrapyard: One person's junk is still junk, but useful
Scrapyard built.
A gift for the goal: Lifting Gloves (in the stash).
📻 Dusk Radio: Listener request: upgrade the Camp to a Lodge. ⚙ 4  🪵 8  ★ 6 Time to move up. Tap your Camp, then Upgrade. It needs wood and scrap. Idle people chop trees and strip wrecks on their own.

Water is going down by 2.4 a day: about 1.9 days left. Tap water at the top to see why.
Kennel: all materials are in, building now.

💥 A Rotbomb burst and hurt 6 survivors.
Remy collapsed! Rescue within 270 s.
Rosa is rescuing Remy.

Rosa picked up Remy.
Kennel: Good dogs wanted
Kennel built.
Ready for the next level: open Upgrade (tap the Renown wheel or Town) to start it.
The Haven is working toward level 9: 1 day in real time (it keeps going while the app is closed, and renown can speed it up).
HAVEN LEVEL 9!
📻 Dusk Radio: Level 9. The zombies have noticed too. They're your biggest fans.
Remy reached the Medical Tent.
Pip and Zane are now close friends.
Weather report: ❄️ Snow 15:00–17:00. Tomorrow: Heavy rain 10:00–12:00.
18 zombies are still about from the night. In daylight they are slow and weak: the fighters go out after them.
Dawn: fewer zombies until nightfall.
Remy recovered and returned.
📻 Dusk Radio: Day 70. Somebody out there is having a worse morning, and it's chewing on your gate. Word is: garden Plot has no Farmer: change someone's profession.
📻 Helix Biotech: Hello! Dr. Voss, Helix Biotech. We've had a look at your bite records. One of them is... interesting. We'd love a chat.
Leo collapsed! Rescue within 270 s.
Zane is rescuing Leo.
⚔ RALLY: FIGHTERS MOVE TO COVER LEO
